columns.name: sku
columns.description: Stock keeping unit filed by the operator (AC1). NOT NULL per PI2.

columns.name: location
columns.description: Storage location the SKU is filed at (AC1). NOT NULL per PI2.

columns.name: quantity
columns.description: Filed quantity; can never be negative per PI3/NFR2. NOT NULL per PI2.

columns.name: inventory_code
columns.description: Combined tracking code filed with the record (AC1). NOT NULL per PI2.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: Row creation timestamp; preserved across additive migrations (PI4/R1).

columns.name: updated_at
columns.description: Last write timestamp; refreshed on an in-place refile (AC2).

schema_changes.detail: Create stock_records with id (identity PK), sku, location, quantity, inventory_code (all NOT NULL), created_at/updated_at (NOT NULL default now()), composite UNIQUE (sku, location), and CHECK (quantity >= 0).
schema_changes.migration_note: Additive create_table. downgrade() drops the table; upgrade()/downgrade() are symmetric and any rows created before this migration are untouched, satisfying the reversible-migration invariant (PI4/R1).
